## 📄 Documentation Type

<!-- What type of documentation needs improvement? Check all that apply. -->

- [ ] 📖 **README** - Main project README
- [ ] 📘 **API Reference** - Class/method/decorator documentation
- [ ] 🎓 **Tutorial/Guide** - Step-by-step learning content
- [ ] 💡 **Examples** - Code examples or sample projects
- [ ] 🔧 **Configuration** - Setup and configuration docs
- [ ] 🚀 **Migration Guide** - Version upgrade instructions
- [ ] ❓ **FAQ** - Frequently asked questions
- [ ] 🏗️ **Architecture** - Design decisions and architecture docs
- [ ] 📦 **Package/Release Notes** - Changelog or release documentation
- [ ] 🌐 **Website** - Official website content (https://expressive-tea.io)
- [ ] 💬 **JSDoc/Code Comments** - Inline code documentation
- [ ] 🔗 **Other** - Describe below

**Page/Section URL or File Path:**

**What's the issue?**
<!-- Choose one or more -->
- [ ] 📭 **Missing documentation** - Feature/API is not documented at all
- [ ] 🤔 **Unclear/confusing** - Explanation is hard to understand
- [ ] 📅 **Outdated** - Content is no longer accurate for current version
- [ ] ❌ **Incorrect** - Contains factual errors or wrong information
- [ ] 🐛 **Broken links/references** - Links don't work or point to wrong location
- [ ] 💻 **Code examples don't work** - Examples are broken or outdated
- [ ] 🔍 **Incomplete** - Missing important details or edge cases
- [ ] 🎨 **Formatting issues** - Rendering, layout, or style problems
- [ ] 🌍 **Translation needed** - Needs translation to another language
